# Initialize variables with integer values
number_a = 5
number_b = 10

# Calculate the sum using the addition operator
total_sum = number_a + number_b

# Print the formatted result to the console
print(f"The sum is: {total_sum}")

Why does this code work?

data_object Variables

We use number_a and number_b as containers to hold our integer values (5 and 10) so we can reference them later.

calculate Operations

The + operator performs arithmetic addition. Python automatically handles the math since both inputs are numbers.

We use an f-string inside print() to embed the calculated total_sum directly into the text message.
